readerContract.humanQuestion: How can women using AI make the group stronger together, rather than merely pass around one person’s clever answer?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Use one small shared-method practice to invite another woman’s contribution, protect her judgment and improve the result together.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No AI expertise is assumed; the reader may have used a chat tool or watched a colleague use one.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: A chorus becomes fuller when each person can hear the shared shape and add her own part; an AI practice becomes more useful when people share a method and contribute their different context and checks.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: Two colleagues turn separate meeting notes into follow-ups for different clients, then compare what their shared method missed.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A private 250–350-word NewsStand Patron Saint feature that makes community and rising together the central learning outcome, with existing card and KSVL links.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I have something useful to contribute, and I can invite another woman to make the shared practice better.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Teach one distinction—answer versus method—without defining a vocabulary list.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The planned article follows one colleague handover from one answer to an adaptable method.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Use continuous feature prose with one worked case, not repeated tips or status boxes.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The three reader fields move from problem to mechanism to one action.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: The chorus comparison must explain how different women add context and checks to a shared result; do not use Sister Mary Clarence as generic brand decoration.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The planned mechanism names the task, inputs, instruction, check and human judgment without relying on film knowledge.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: One named fictional Patron Saint frame and one general chorus comparison; no film scene, quote or lyric.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The draft plan names no other cultural reference.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Show why different context and checks expose weaknesses in one person’s answer and strengthen the next shared version.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The causal sequence separates the result, its inputs/instruction/check, and the colleague’s revision.

genericAction.producerGuard: Ask one colleague to adapt a low-stakes task, name what her context changed and add one check to the shared note.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The useful action tells the reader whom to ask, what to share and what feedback to request.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Use ordinary work language; do not introduce technical AI terms.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The article begins with a familiar colleague handover.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Keep the person, the task, AI draft and human check in one visible sequence.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The worked case maps each step to a colleague’s distinct adaptation.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use warm, adult prose and a realistic meeting-follow-up example instead of a checklist.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The lesson gives a concrete social payoff: another woman can improve the method rather than depend on the expert.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Make one transferable sharing move, not a universal productivity doctrine.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The conclusion applies the method note to one low-stakes task only.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Open with the burden of becoming the unofficial AI help desk before explaining the method.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The reader’s actual question leads the article.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Keep the meeting-follow-up example short and return to the reader’s own task.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The transfer action is a separate task selected by the reader.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Use task, notes, instruction, check and judgment; avoid agent, prompt-engineering or workflow-system language.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: R2 qualitative repair: The planned explanation requires no product-specific or engineering terminology.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Bring another woman along by sharing enough of a useful AI method for her to adapt it, add her own judgment and improve the shared result; the chorus comparison explains why each contribution matters.
causalSequence: One person’s polished answer can leave everyone else as spectators.
A shared method reveals the work shape without pretending every situation is identical.
Different women supply different context, questions and checks.
Their contributions expose what the original answer missed and strengthen the next shared version.
A small invitation to try and improve the method turns private know-how into a chorus.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Two colleagues turn separate meeting notes into follow-ups for different clients; each adapts a shared method, then identifies a missing check the other would not have seen.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A third colleague uses the same shared shape for a manager briefing and adds a different audience-specific check before returning it to the group.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose one low-stakes task; invite one woman to adapt your method on her own version and ask what her context changed, what she checked and what should be added to the shared note.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Short warm feature: community problem, plain fictional-character boundary, chorus comparison, one real collaboration case, one compact bring-someone-along action, exact card and existing KSVL button. No community URL.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: The article does not lead with a four-field framework or treat a method note as the lesson. The shared result and each woman’s contribution are the main through-line.

analogyPlan.concept: Different contributors make a shared practice stronger
analogyPlan.analogy: A chorus where people hear the shared shape and add distinct parts
analogyPlan.mapping: A shared AI method lets colleagues adapt it with their own context, find missing checks and improve the next version together.
analogyPlan.limit: This is a general chorus comparison, not a description or quotation of a film scene; Sister Mary Clarence remains a fictional LAiDIES teaching frame.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It makes collaboration visible: the goal is not uniformity or one expert solo, but a stronger shared result.

humourPlan.lessonJob: No joke; the chorus comparison supplies warmth and the causal teaching job.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Use the benchmark as a plain-explanation lens for a short NewsStand teaching feature; adapt the mechanics, never the voice or persona.

humanQuestion.reason: The reader needs to share a useful AI practice without becoming the permanent intermediary.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Open with the cost of one person becoming the answer desk, then shift to a shared result.

usefulCuriosity.reason: A polished final answer looks shareable but does not tell a colleague how to adapt it.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Ask why forwarding one good answer does not make a group capable.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: The useful work lies in the otherwise hidden choices behind the answer.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Show each colleague bringing different notes, context and checks to the same broad task.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: A familiar colleague handover explains the AI collaboration practice without technical vocabulary.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Use a chorus to clarify the social mechanism, then return to two work follow-ups.

limitationsConsequences.reason: The method helps adaptation but does not transfer judgment or justify sharing sensitive details.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: State that shared structure does not erase judgment or permit sensitive detail sharing.

humourSurprise.reason: The short feature needs no joke beyond its warm Sister Mary Clarence frame.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The reader should leave able to ask what another person needs in order to use and improve the method.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: End by asking what another woman’s context changes and what should be added to the shared method.

explanationArc.sharedStartingPoint: A useful AI practice currently lives with one person, while others need to make their own work stronger.
explanationArc.curiosityGap: What does it take to turn one useful answer into a practice that helps a group rise together?
mechanismSequence: One person’s polished answer can leave everyone else as spectators.
A shared method reveals the work shape without pretending every situation is identical.
Different women supply different context, questions and checks.
Their contributions expose what the original answer missed and strengthen the next shared version.
A small invitation to try and improve the method turns private know-how into a chorus.
explanationArc.earnedClick: The shared asset is not a final answer or a prompt; it is a revisable method made stronger by different women’s judgment.
explanationArc.smallLanding: Invite one colleague to adapt a low-stakes task and name her improvement.
explanationArc.safetyBoundary: No community/chat claim, sensitive work detail, film-scene assertion, quotation, lyric or product capability claim.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: The Saint frame becomes decorative or the action remains generic.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Read the complete candidate aloud against the exact profile/feature direction; verify the article has one causal mechanism, a concrete colleague case, a distinct transfer, a bounded action, the existing card route and the exact track ID.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A reader can state why a final answer is insufficient and write a four-part method note another woman can test and improve.
